lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A spatial arrangement consisting of four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs. The two medial rows exhibit larger pixel clusters with higher peak intensity than the dorsal or ventral-most rows visible on the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse, elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots at regular intervals, forming a rectilinear grid of high-luminance nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible. The superior ridge shows a high-contrast vertical gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal edge and a defined shadow cast along the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance clusters concentrated primarily near the base and along the leading edge of the first dorsal fin's visible silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-frequency cluster of micro-spots is visible on the anterior snout and pre-orbital region, distinctly smaller and more densely packed than the flank constellation.
